answer: In an agent economy trading orchard fruit, pearl jewelry, and trellis kits, each seller must lock a 100-token bond for 30 days to receive one order slot per day. Slots scale with bonded capital, not account count, so splitting funds across identities creates no extra capacity. A thousand fake sellers require 100,000 locked tokens, tying up the attacker’s capital and imposing financing costs even if no orders arrive.
